resources.title: BadUpdate 1.3
resources.description: Temporary homebrew entry point for dashboard 17559, using a supported game and its matching save. The original repository is archived; read its game-specific instructions. A separate homebrew payload is required and the exploit must be run again after reboot.

resources.title: ABadAvatar · public beta
resources.description: Alternative dashboard/avatar entry point for a temporary homebrew session. Requires the Avatar update data and an additional XEX payload. Follow the developer’s offline/profile instructions; it is separate from the persistent Peer Pressure softmod.

resources.title: FreeMyXe 1.2.1
resources.description: Lightweight BadUpdate payload that applies runtime patches for homebrew, XeLL and LibXenon. The release includes a XeLL build. Use it for the temporary exploit workflow; the developer explicitly rules out NAND-modifying homebrew on this setup.

resources.title: XeUnshackle · beta 1.03
resources.description: Alternative BadUpdate payload with kernel/hypervisor patches, CPU/DVD-key display and an in-memory DashLaunch module. It returns to an unmodified state after power-off. Its plugin workflow applies to BadUpdate and must not be applied to Peer Pressure.

resources.title: XeLL Reloaded 0.993
resources.description: Linux and LibXenon ELF loader with USB, HDD and network boot support. Choose the binary matching the documented JTAG, RGH or BadUpdate chain-loading route. This is a loader resource for an established setup, not a standalone retail-console installer.

resources.title: FATXplorer · Windows x64
resources.description: Desktop Xbox storage explorer for mounting FATX partitions, transferring files and preparing supported drives. The linked 3.0 beta needs the .NET 10 Desktop Runtime. Review its drive-specific requirements before formatting; formatting erases the selected device.

resources.title: Velocity · Windows
resources.description: Open source desktop browser/editor for Xbox 360 packages, profiles and FATX/STFS/XDBF data. Use copies of your own files when inspecting or editing packages. This Windows build runs on your computer and does not enable homebrew on a retail console.

resources.title: XeCLI 2.0 · Windows x64
resources.description: Portable console-management toolkit with a desktop terminal, file transfers, diagnostics and XEX inspection. Live console commands require an RGH/JTAG setup with a compatible XBDM plugin; some functions also require JRPC2 or FTP. Peer Pressure does not support that DashLaunch-plugin setup.
